# UX/UI Agent Skills provenance

- Repository: https://github.com/plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills
- Pinned revision: `ef2048fef3e76a954b67cfcf3a53123983416bc7`
- Retrieved: 2026-08-26
- Upstream paths reviewed: `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`, `README.md`, `package.json`, and the associated knowledge-layer directories.

The portable skills in this repository are deliberately adapted rather than copied verbatim. They retain the upstream capability boundaries while using Agents-DevKits routing, capability fallbacks, and evidence contracts. No upstream scripts, product templates, brand-library material, credentials, or provider configuration is bundled here.

The upstream repository declares the MIT license in its `README.md` and `package.json`. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).
